title: Noon Kitchen — a neighborhood lunch counter for the in-between hour
audience: angel investors reviewing a single-location restaurant concept
core_points: Concept: a 22-seat counter open 11am-3pm daily, built around one hot special and a cold bar
Named Noon because the best hour is the one between errands — nobody is really serving that hour well
Menu logic: one rotating hot bowl, a salad trio, two sandwiches, two soft drinks, one dessert
Sourcing: four farm partners within 60 miles, seasonality-led, menu changes every 10 days
Founder team: Sofia Prieto (chef, ex-Zuni), Roman Quint (FOH, ex-Camino), two culinary-school seconds
Location: 1,200 sqft on a corner of Valencia and 21st, 4-year lease at $7,800/mo
Fit-out budget: $320K (kitchen, counter, copper bar, chairs, signage), 11 weeks build-out
Revenue model: 110 covers/day × $24 average ticket × 5.5 days = $1.4M annual; 18% EBITDA
Year-1 risks: chef turnover (mitigated with equity), lunch fatigue (mitigated with menu rotation), weather
Opening 45-day pre-launch plan: neighbor preview nights, press tastings, chef demos, soft open
Ask: $480K friends-and-family round at a $2.2M post; we close by month-end, doors open in 6 months
